responsibility: Supplies LoongArch target overrides for bare ELF environments that are not the GNU userland configurations handled by gnu-user.h. It fixes basic ABI properties such as wchar_t size, selects the linker emulation string, and defines the target’s default link, library, startfile, endfile, and cc1 specs for Newlib-style systems, including libc/libgloss grouping and simple profiling support.
